title: Daybreak
subtitle: 4K intro · 60 s
author: Opus
notes: DB32 demo  --  CPU sequencer + GPU renderer + SPU synth in 4096 bytes
CPU: apply MMIO config script, then render loop
copy r3 words from r1 to r2
GPU kernel: one invocation per pixel.
excerpt:
.profile spu-1
.entry start
.equ FB0,   0x10000
.equ FB1,   0x1E100
.equ AOUT,  0x2C200
start:
    li r1, cfg
cfg_next:
    lw r2, 0(r1)            ; destination (0 terminates)
    beq r2, r0, cfg_done
    lw r3, 4(r1)            ; word count
    addi r1, r1, 8
    jal r15, copy
    j cfg_next
copy:
    lw r4, 0(r1)
    sw r4, 0(r2)
    addi r1, r1, 4
description: A journey from night to full daylight in eight scenes, cut to an original 128 BPM electronic track.
